cut.name: obj_tenna_enemy event_user(2) ladder (Other_12) — incl. the TRIPLE FEATURE
cut.evidence: gml_Object_obj_tenna_enemy_Other_12.gml:1-78 is a complete alternative 18-step chooser (phaseturn 1..18 -> choices 0/1/2/3/20, `myattackchoice = choose(0, 1, 2)` at :59, `_minigamecount = 3` at :71). It is orphaned: obj_tenna_enemy only ever calls event_user(0) (Step_0:50), and it writes `_minigamecount`, a var LOCAL to Other_10, which proves it was split off from the live chooser. Consequently `minigametype3` / `difficulty3` — plumbed all the way through obj_tenna_enemy_Step_0.gml:1230-1231, obj_tenna_zoom_Create_0.gml:32-33 and the con == 3 chain at obj_tenna_zoom_Step_0.gml:769-798 — can never be reached: the live chooser sets _minigamecount to 1 or 2 only (Other_10:1, :51).

mechanics: WIN CONDITION IS POINTS, NOT HP. Tenna has 5500 HP (scr_monstersetup.gml:1861-1866) but the fight ends when obj_tenna_enemy_bg.myscore reaches 1000 AND haveusedultimate is true (Step_0:37-42). Encounter 121 (scr_encountersetup.gml:867-880) is SOLO — monstertype[1] and [2] are 0. THREE TURN KINDS: (a) ordinary bullet turns, myattackchoice 0/1/2, red soul in the standard box created at Step_0:557-558; (b) PHYSICAL CHALLENGE turns, myattackchoice 3, which set minigametransition_con = 1 (Step_0:600-608), fly obj_actor_tenna into the screen and create obj_tenna_zoom (Step_0:1183-1243), which is a second dispatcher keyed on a STRING minigametype plus an int difficulty; (c) the LIGHT 'EM UP finale. Minigame turns run at turntimer 999 with a hard floor of 4 (obj_tenna_zoom_Step_0.gml:14-15) and end by forcing global.turntimer to 1 (Step_0:1260-1261). Failing a minigame does not damage you during it: obj_tenna_zoom counts minigamefailcount, and the boss cashes it in afterwards at Step_0:1298-1375 for 56 / 26 / 18 damage per fail. HOW A MINIGAME TURN IS TRIGGERED: the player ACTing 'Minigame' (Step_0:861-872, acting 5.1 sets minigameactivated), OR Tenna's HP dropping to 50% (Other_10:34-39, which then forces choice 3 EVERY turn), OR minigameinsanity. DOUBLE FEATURE: once minigamecount >= 6 the chooser sets _minigamecount = 2 (Other_10:47-52) and queues two minigames in one turn via minigametype2; obj_tenna_zoom chains them at con == 3 (Step_0:769-798). MINIGAME ORDER is a global.tempflag[91] ladder (Other_10:78-292): 1 cooking, 2 music, 3 battle d1, 4 cowboy d0, 5 music, 7 susiezilla d2 or battle d2, 8 cowboy d1, 9 music, 10 cowboy d0, 12 battle d2, 13 music, 14 cooking, 15 susiezilla d3 or battle d1, 16 cowboy d1, then a weighted random pool (choose(0,0,0,1,2,3,4,5), or choose(0,0,0,1,3,4,5,6,7) with global.flag[1197] > 0) with a 3-pass anti-repeat filter. FINAL PHASE (MINIGAME INSANITY): HP <= 20% or score >= 1000 sets minigameinsanity (Other_10:9-10); obj_tenna_zoom then channel-surfs between minigames on a timer that shrinks 120 -> 30 (Step_0:299-311), and on the 5th flip at 30 it forces battle d3 and sets the boss's phaseturn = 18 (:423-436), which is LIGHT 'EM UP. SOUL MODES: red soul only for 125/126/128 and battle d2; the sharpshoot and LIGHT 'EM UP turns replace the soul with an aiming cursor (obj_lightemup_controller_Create_0.gml:22-37) and reposition/re-sprite all three heroes into zoo suits; cowboy uses obj_shootout_heart; music, cooking and susiezilla replace player control entirely. SIDE SYSTEMS the boss Step also runs: the score/points meter (obj_tenna_enemy_bg, addscore/myscore/maxscore 1000), Susie's BET act (Step_0:959-993, 20 pts, 30 with the Jevil tail), Ralsei's POPULAR BOY act linking his HP to score (Step_0:1046-1096, 773-774), the Lancer stool cheat (Step_0:757-769, 1160-1181), and a 22-step balloon-dialogue state machine (Step_0:71-545) with a sword-route branch on global.flag[1050].
engineNeeds: The three ordinary bullet attacks (125 / 126 / 128) are conventional obj_dbulletcontroller work and should run: obj_tenna_allstars_manager, obj_tenna_smashcut_attack, obj_tenna_rimshot_star and obj_lensflare_manager are all already in docs/js/gml_objects.js. Caveats: obj_tenna_allstars_manager uses ds_list plus two surfaces and a GML 2.3 `spawn_new = function(arg0)` method, and it opens with snd_loop(snd_crowd_laughter_loop). Everything else needs new engine work. (1) THE MINIGAME TURN IS NOT AN ANNOUNCED ATTACK. The myattackchoice == 3 branch (Step_0:600-608) sets no global.monsterattackname and creates no controller, so gen_attacks.js's announcement scan yields nothing for the 10 real PHYSICAL CHALLENGE variants. They need a declared launch mode the way Pink's dates do (`launch: 'tenna-minigame'` with minigametype + difficulty) that creates obj_tenna_zoom directly with those two fields set, skipping the obj_actor_tenna jump-in. (2) TYPE-150 DEDUP COLLISION. Three separate dispatches produce obj_dbulletcontroller.type = 150 — Step_0:609-615 (cut choice 20), obj_tenna_zoom_Other_11.gml:251-267 (sharpshoot) and :358-377 (LIGHT 'EM UP). gen_attacks.js's dedup key is boss|controller|type|pattern|datecount, so all three collapse into ONE entry and the CUT choice-20 one wins (it is scanned first). By luck that entry still plays the real finale — obj_lightemup_controller_Create_0.gml:1-8 only downgrades the target to type 5 when myattackchoice == 21 or obj_tenna_zoom.minigamedifficulty == 1, neither of which holds — but the sharpshoot variant becomes unreachable from the dropdown unless obj_tenna_zoom is faked with minigamedifficulty = 1. (3) obj_lightemup_controller's Create references obj_tenna_enemy, obj_herokris, obj_herosusie and obj_heroralsei UNGUARDED and calls scr_act_charsprite on all three; the studio must have a full three-hero party. (4) UNIMPLEMENTED NATIVES: the cowboy minigame's setup calls layer_create, layer_background_create, layer_background_htiled, layer_background_stretch and layer_background_speed (obj_tenna_zoom_Other_11.gml:221-243) — all five are in docs/js/native_gaps.json, and obj_tenna_zoom_Other_11.gml is literally the cited example for layer_background_speed. (5) obj_tenna_zoom's transition does sprite_create_from_surface(application_surface, ...) (Step_0:117) and drives four scr_lerpvar tweens over surfaces; the zoom is cosmetic and can be stubbed by jumping straight to con = 1 with event_user(1) already fired. (6) susiezilla needs obj_mainchara.cutscene, a 1280-wide game_bounds sub-world, scr_script_delayed and scr_dark_marker; cooking needs the whole obj_chefs_* kitchen plus scr_chefs_end; music needs obj_rhythmgame_chart and audio-synced charting. (7) NO TURN BLOCK is supplied on purpose: every Tenna turn length lives INSIDE its dispatcher branch (200 / 260 / 260 / 999 / 999999) and is therefore carried by the per-attack `setup` slice. The only out-of-branch call is the raise-only scr_turntimer(90) floor at Step_0:565, which is identical to the studio's own default, so a turnBlock would be a no-op — and any slice wide enough to include it is either brace-unbalanced or re-runs the spawners (the Knight double-spawn trap).
exclusions: obj_tenna_board4_enemy (encounters 133 / 134 / 135, scr_encountersetup.gml:1106 / 1122 / 1144) is the mid-chapter BOARD 4 Tenna, not this fight: it is a different object with its own Create/Step/Other_10, it appears alongside obj_shadowman_enemy and obj_zapper_enemy, it has one unconditional attack (`"rimshot lensflare"` -> dc.type = 125 at its Step_0:465-468 — note it reuses type 125 under a DIFFERENT name), and its Other_10 ladder assigns myattackchoice 1/4/5/6/7/8, values its own Step never tests. obj_tenna_board4_gacha, obj_board_*, obj_tennaPresetTester and obj_tenna_battle_idleanimtest are overworld/dev objects with no monsterparent lineage. The obj_shootout_*, obj_rhythmgame_*, obj_chefs_* and obj_susiezilla_* objects are NOT excluded as 'minigames' because in this fight they are not standalone sections — they are the boss's attacks, reached from obj_tenna_enemy's own turn dispatcher via myattackchoice == 3; the standalone versions of the same games live in their own rooms (room_dw_chef_empty / room_dw_rhythm_empty / room_dw_susiezilla_empty, obj_tenna_zoom_Other_13.gml:1-8) and are reached with minigametype strings ('chef board 4', 'rythm board 4', 'susiezilla board 4') that obj_tenna_enemy never produces.
